entry.name: Meowstic Mega
entry.flavorEs: El fuerte instinto protector de los machos los lleva a liberar todo su poder cuando se trata de defenderse a sí mismos o a su Entrenador.
entry.flavorZh: 雄性的防卫本能很强， 在保护自己和伙伴时 能发挥最大的威力。

abilities.textEn: On switch-in, or when it can, this Pokemon copies a random adjacent foe's Ability.
abilities.textEs: Al entrar en combate copia la habilidad del rival.
abilities.detail: On switch-in, this Pokemon copies a random opposing Pokemon's Ability. Abilities that cannot be copied are As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Teraform Zero, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Trace, Zen Mode, and Zero to Hero. If no opposing Pokemon has an Ability that can be copied, this Ability will activate as soon as one does.
abilities.detailEs: Cuando este Pokémon entra en combate, copia la habilidad de un rival al azar. Esta habilidad no puede copiar Don Floral, Predicción, Ilusión, Impostor, Multitipo, Rastro, Superguarda ni Modo Daruma.
abilities.detailZh: 当该宝可梦进入战斗时，会复制随机一名对手的特性。该特性无法复制花之礼、阴晴不定、幻觉、变身者、多属性、复制、神奇守护和达摩模式。
abilities.detailPt: Quando este Pokémon entra em batalha, ele copia a habilidade de um oponente aleatório. Esta habilidade não pode copiar Flower Gift, Forecast, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Trace, Wonder Guard ou Zen Mode.
